steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application package name and display name for Charging Voice Alert inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Establish Build Environment
steps.description: Setup app/build.gradle using AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and SDK 34 compatibility rules without external dependencies.

steps.title: Implement App Colors and Style Resources
steps.description: Create color definitions and core theme style declarations based on Material design in standard colors.xml and themes.xml.

steps.title: Build Main Activity User Interface Layout
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml layout with battery levels, status indicators, start/stop buttons, alert preference switches, and battery settings information.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest Requirements
steps.description: Establish proper permissions including foreground services, boot capabilities, and dynamic notification actions inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Boot Completion Broadcast Receiver
steps.description: Implement BootReceiver.java to automatically restore the foreground battery monitoring service upon device reboot if enabled.

steps.title: Implement Background Foreground Monitor Service
steps.description: Develop ChargingMonitorService.java to handle background lifecycle operations and start persistent status notifications.

steps.title: Integrate Battery Broadcast State Monitor
steps.description: Create dynamic battery broadcast handlers inside the background service to continuously capture power states, percentages, and transitions.

steps.title: Integrate Native Text-To-Speech Interface
steps.description: Build voice synthesis algorithms using Android TextToSpeech to deliver Hindi-friendly spoken alerts safely without duplicates.

steps.title: Develop Main Controller Interface Logic
steps.description: Complete MainActivity.java implementation linking interactive UI actions, shared preferences status updating, and battery optimization redirection.

steps.title: Handle Dynamic Notification Permission
steps.description: Write permission checks inside MainActivity for API level 33+ devices to allow posting required active service notifications.

steps.title: Verify State Handling Rules
steps.description: Confirm execution of speech queue constraints, power plug status updates, and session state reset transitions.

steps.title: Building Charging Voice Alert
steps.description: Trigger compilation, clean build validation, resource linking, and APK generation.
